1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

1992|05f55f8a.name: Tarindrella
1992|05f55f8a.text: Only in Nature do we find purity.

2079|26ba7149.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
2079|26ba7149.text: Ah, the beauty of Shadowglen never ceases to delight my senses!

2080|ac9bd966.name: Denalan
2080|ac9bd966.text: The creation of Teldrassil was a grand achievement, but now the world must shift to regain its balance.

2215|dc484bb4.name: High Executor Darthalia
2215|dc484bb4.text: In order to serve the Dark Lady and Varimathras we need to advance the front on the Human Infestation.

2216|8e0e34da.name: Apothecary Lydon
2216|8e0e34da.text: We are but so close to developing the New Plague that our Dark Lady desires with such fervor.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2388|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Shay
2388|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

2389|c5ceacbe.name: Zarise
2389|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

248840|280b51d5.name: Trevan Rol
248840|280b51d5.text: In the darkest of nights, trust in the light to protect you. Of course, having a nice, sturdy mace doesn't hurt either.

248840|ed3d7580.name: Trevan Rol
248840|ed3d7580.text:
The Son of Arugal that attacked Lumina is known as Old Fire-Eye. He's not only well-known for his ferocity, but for his stubborn refusal to die. I've been doing a fair amount of research and I think that we can forge a blade that will do the trick and put him down for good.

Here, I've prepared a list of materials and information about how to get them for you. When you've gathered what we need, return to me and we'll get started.

259620|334a03a9.name: Lumina Windsinger
259620|334a03a9.text:
When it was over I was stunned. He knew what would happen and he threw himself in front of that creature anyway to shield me.

We windshapers always pay our debts, and I owe him a debt. We've already avenged his death, but we can still avenge what was done to him by that monster, if you are still willing to lend me aid.

259620|5469c573.name: Lumina Windsinger
259620|5469c573.text: There are no words to describe what happened. Banon twisted and contorted horribly. It sounded like every bone in his body was breaking. His mouth filled with razors and his hands became deadly claws. It took twenty gnolls to fell him, and he killed half of them before it was done.

259620|a831a213.name: Lumina Windsinger
259620|a831a213.text:
As I said, the creature that attacked us fled when I singed its backside with lightning, but not before biting Banon. On our way back to town, the gnolls surrounded us and took us captive. 

It wasn't until they started to pull us out of the boat on Fenris Isle that... the change started.

260093|58279558.name: Garen Largo
260093|58279558.text: Do you require training in the ways of the light?

3567|0e584820.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
3567|0e584820.text: Well met, $N. It is good to see that druids like yourself are taking an active part in protecting the groves.

3596|f9b860f0.name: Ayanna Everstride
3596|f9b860f0.text: I cannot train a $c such as yourself.

3597|e653c173.name: Mardant Strongoak
3597|e653c173.text:
Welcome, my sister.  If you are here to train, then I would be delighted to train you.

There will be a time soon where the call of the Emerald Dream will take hold in you.  You will hibernate for many years and walk amongst the purest of forms.  It is there and then that your ultimate training will take place.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4596|b22b0c37.name: James Van Brunt
4596|b22b0c37.text: How is the edge of your steel? Good enough to cut through the belly of your enemy? Let me show you some things to make it even sharper.

4605|e9a5758c.name: Basil Frye
4605|e9a5758c.text: You have learned much, more than I can teach. Go to James Van Brunt, he will teach you what I cannot.

5624|dd3eed63.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|dd3eed63.text: We not so sure paladins safe to touch, but they at War Quarter in big building.

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

6094|a28d29e1.name: Byancie
6094|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

6286|f842f7e5.name: Zarrin
6286|f842f7e5.text: Hello, $N. If you'd like to learn a thing or two about cooking, please visit me at any time.

6736|41276936.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
6736|41276936.text: Your body looks worn and your spirit weary. Rest yourself beneath our roof and allow Elune to guide your dreams.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

1014-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-complete.text: Silverpine Forest is finally free from the vice of that wretch Arugal. You have done the Dark Lady a great service, $N. Your tenacity shall be rewarded.
1014-complete.title: Arugal Must Die

1014-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
1014-progress.text: With Arugal's death we stand to increase the Dark Lady's stronghold on Lordaeron.
1014-progress.title: Arugal Must Die

1098-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
1098-complete.text:
Vincent's body lies broken, and still.

Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.

But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
1098-complete.title: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang

2159-accept.name: Porthannius
2159-accept.text:
Greetings, young $c.  Can you offer me aid?  I have a package of herbs that I must deliver to the town of Dolanaar.  But I still have business with the druids of Shadowglen and cannot yet leave.

Can you deliver this package for me?  It must be sent to Innkeeper Keldamyr, at the Dolanaar inn.  It lies along the road, to the south.
2159-accept.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2159-complete.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-complete.text:
Ah yes, the delivery of herbs from Shadowglen.  It is a shame Porthannius could not bring it himself, for we have much to discuss, he and I.  But I am glad to get the herbs nonetheless, and I am glad you came.

While you are here, please, rest yourself.  Heroes must keep their strength and spirits high, and must find rest and solace whenever they may.  For to neglect one's peace of body and mind is a sure path to failure.

So... rest.
2159-complete.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2159-progress.name: Innkeeper Keldamyr
2159-progress.text: How might I be of service to you, young one?  Are you here to rest in the inn?  Do you require a hearthstone?
2159-progress.title: Dolanaar Delivery

2438-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-accept.text:
I was once given an emerald dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, the warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. This powerful amulet is able to siphon energy from the Emerald Dream, bestowing luck upon those who carry it.

Sadly, I have not been able to retrieve it from my dresser in Starbreeze Village... Although Starbreeze was once a tranquil place, it has now succumbed to the corruption of the furbolg that reside there.

Perhaps you would be willing to recover my dreamcatcher, $c?
2438-accept.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2438-complete.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-complete.text: My emerald dreamcatcher is of great importance to me. It is a gift only given to few. Thank you for returning it, $N.
2438-complete.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2438-progress.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2438-progress.text:
Please move swiftly. I can only hope that my emerald dreamcatcher has been unharmed by the furbolg.

Have you recovered it yet, $N?
2438-progress.title: The Emerald Dreamcatcher

2459-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
2459-accept.text:
The emerald... It is missing! My dreamcatcher has been damaged!

There is a band of Gnarlpine mystics located to the north of Starbreeze. I have heard reports that their leader, Ferocitas the Dream Eater has been wearing a necklace that glows green in the night. Now seeing my dreamcatcher, I am sure that he has stolen my emerald... He would never realize that its power is useless to him.

Find this missing jewel, $N. And, while you're there, clear out some of the corrupted mystics as well.
2459-accept.title: Ferocitas the Dream Eater

3120-progress.name: Mardant Strongoak
3120-progress.text:
Ah, young $c. I see you're eager to continue your studies. Good.

I wonder, have you spent much time in the Emerald Dream already? Perhaps you're not prepared for that yet... In time, I'm sure.

But until then, we should discuss other matters.
3120-progress.title: Verdant Sigil

3519-accept.name: Iverron
3519-accept.text:
Ughhh... I was bitten very badly by a spider named Githyiss the Vile while exploring the spider cave very close to here. I am sure I have been seriously poisoned; you must help me.

Please tell Dirania Silvershine. She will be able to help me.

Hurry... I'm so dizzy...
3519-accept.title: A Friend in Need

3519-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3519-complete.text: Oh dear; I was wondering why I hadn't seen Iverron yet today. And I've always warned him about those spiders...
3519-complete.title: A Friend in Need

3521-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-accept.text:
We may be able to help Iverron, as I know of an antidote that should help with the poison. It requires some ingredients, though, before I can make it.

I'll need Hyacinth mushrooms. You can find these growing under trees, or you may collect them from the grell south of here; they seem to have taken a liking to them. I'll also need Moonpetal lilies, which only grow around watery pools.

The last ingredient may prove the most difficult. From the very spiders that poisoned Iverron, collect Webwood ichor.
3521-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-complete.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-complete.text:
Thank Elune that you have gathered these ingredients so quickly!

In just a moment, I will have the antidote prepared.
3521-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3521-progress.name: Dirania Silvershine
3521-progress.text: Please, collect the ingredients, $N. Iverron needs our help.
3521-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-accept.name: Dirania Silvershine
3522-accept.text:
The antidote is ready, $N. Please see that Iverron drinks it.

There is something that you should know -- the antidote -- it will only remain viable for 5 minutes. You must get it to him in time.

Speed be with you, $N.
3522-accept.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-complete.name: Iverron
3522-complete.text:
What is this, $N?

Oh, I knew Dirania would be able to help me!

<Iverron drinks the antidote.>

I'm always getting into trouble and Dirania, well, she always manages to help me out of it.

I am feeling much better, but I think I will sit here for a while longer, until I feel completely better. Well, that, and I was hoping you'd clear a path for me through those vicious Webwood spiders...
3522-complete.title: Iverron's Antidote

3522-progress.name: Iverron
3522-progress.text: Oh... $N, I'm so glad you have returned.
3522-progress.title: Iverron's Antidote

4161-accept.name: Zarrin
4161-accept.text:
Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." Learning of the past is an important step in your path as a $c, $N, so listen well to what I have to tell you.

The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. This balance has afforded us much, $N.

Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.
4161-accept.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-complete.name: Zarrin
4161-complete.text: Always remember what I have shown you today, $N. You are part of the balance that the night elves strive to keep intact, even during troublesome times.
4161-complete.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

4161-progress.name: Zarrin
4161-progress.text: Remember the balance, $N. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.
4161-progress.title: Recipe of the Kaldorei

425-accept.name: Rane Yorick
425-accept.text:
My brother Quinn and I were tasked to recon Silverpine Forest and report to High Executor Hadrec.  But we didn't get far -- when moving through this farm we were attacked by the ghoul Ivar the Foul.

We escaped from Ivar, but he seriously mauled Quinn.  He's healing from the potion you gave him, but Ivar may return before Quinn recovers.

Kill Ivar so Quinn will have time to heal.  Ivar is usually in the barn yonder, waiting for my guard to drop.
425-accept.title: Ivar the Foul

425-complete.name: Rane Yorick
425-complete.text:
Ah, thank you.  You have my gratitude, $N.

And I will include you in the report I make to my superiors.
425-complete.title: Ivar the Foul

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

442-accept.name: High Executor Hadrec
442-accept.text:
Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle.

You must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw.  I want his head!

This mission is as dangerous as it is vital, $N.  You must not fail.
442-accept.title: Assault on Fenris Isle

442-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
442-complete.text:
The death of Thule Ravenclaw was no small event, $N.  Renferrel tells me that the energies released when you destroyed Thule were felt even as far as the Sepulcher.

Your actions ring through the ranks of the Forsaken.  Your value to us grows.
442-complete.title: Assault on Fenris Isle

442-progress.name: High Executor Hadrec
442-progress.text: The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, $N.  Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.
442-progress.title: Assault on Fenris Isle

443-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
443-complete.text:
Very good.  This ichor will help us understand the nature of the rot hides, and may show us their weakness...

...if they have one.
443-complete.title: Rot Hide Ichor

444-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
444-accept.text:
I have reduced the ichor you brought me and separated it into its base components.  My findings are not conclusive, but I have determined that warlock and necromantic magics were used in the ichor's creation.

While I continue to study the ichor, I want you to take a sample to Bethor Iceshard in the Undercity.  Bethor is not an apothecary, but his knowledge of magic may help to unravel the mystery of the rot hides.

Go.  You will find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
444-accept.title: Rot Hide Origins

444-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
444-complete.text:
This substance is laced with powerful spells, some of which I have not seen for a long, long time...

One moment -- I must invoke a spell of divination...
444-complete.title: Rot Hide Origins

444-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
444-progress.text: My studies require great concentration.  So I hope your visit is not a frivolous one.
444-progress.title: Rot Hide Origins

446-accept.name: Bethor Iceshard
446-accept.text:
This Ichor was crafted by an old colleague of mine: Thule Ravenclaw.  He was a young, promising mage before the great war, but when the Lich King rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and allied with the Scourge.

I did not realize he still lives, nor that he leads the Rot Hides in their forays against us!

I know many of his spells, and can help concoct a potion to counter them.  Take this scroll back to Apothecary Renferrel.  It has the incantations needed for the potion.
446-accept.title: Thule Ravenclaw

446-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
446-complete.text: This scroll is laced with powerful magic.  I've never used such forces in a potion ... it will be a powerful mixture, and should serve you well should you attack Thule in his stronghold on Fenris Isle.
446-complete.title: Thule Ravenclaw

446-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
446-progress.text: Greetings, $N.  What did Bethor have to say?
446-progress.title: Thule Ravenclaw

448-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
448-accept.text: Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec.  He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.
448-accept.title: Report to Hadrec

448-complete.name: High Executor Hadrec
448-complete.text:
If what Bethor says is true then Thule Ravenclaw is a force that must be dealt with, and dealt with soon.

To aid in this task, you may take something from our arsenal here...
448-complete.title: Report to Hadrec

4495-complete.name: Iverron
4495-complete.text: I'm so glad you found me, $N. How did you know I was here?
4495-complete.title: A Good Friend

450-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
450-complete.text: Apothecary Berard's journal!  Why you are quite brave, $N.  Now let's see what Berard was up to before he went mad. . .
450-complete.title: A Recipe For Death

451-accept.name: Apothecary Renferrel
451-accept.text:
According to Berard's Journal the moss from Lake Skulkers and Creepers might prove useful for our quest to brew a new plague.  Those beasts dwell on the islands in Lake Lordamere to the east.

He also mentions a very rare Hardened Tumor that he discovered on a Vile Fin murloc.  Apparently the tumor is so rare Berard was only able to obtain one.

Collect samples of the moss as well as the rare hardened tumor and take them to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.
451-accept.title: A Recipe For Death

451-complete.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-complete.text:
Such a blow to the Royal Apothecary Society to lose Berard.  But through your hard work and Apothecary Renferrel's diligent research Berard's studies will still be useful to The Dark Lady's plight.

We are on the cusp of something great here, $N.  If you were not so skilled in the ways of combat I would try to recruit you for membership in the Society.
451-complete.title: A Recipe For Death

451-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
451-progress.text: What brings you back to the Undercity, $N?
451-progress.title: A Recipe For Death

452-accept.name: Deathstalker Faerleia
452-accept.text:
You got here just in the nick of time, $N!

The Pyrewood Council will be returning any moment.  Arugal has other matters to tend to in the keep.  He uses the Council as mere puppets to keep the mindless minions of Pyrewood under his control.  But I believe that without the guidance of the Pyrewood Council, the sons of Arugal will turn against their master.

I cannot handle them all by myself.  I need you to help me.  Together we can lay waste to the Council for Lady Sylvanas.
452-accept.title: Pyrewood Ambush

452-complete.name: Deathstalker Faerleia
452-complete.text: You fought like a true disciple of the Dark Lady, $N.  With the council dead, perhaps we can gain control of this town once and for all and drive Arugal from Shadowfang Keep.  I salute you!
452-complete.title: Pyrewood Ambush

457-complete.name: Conservator Ilthalaine
457-complete.text: You have proven your dedication to nature well, $N.  A young $c like yourself has a promising future.
457-complete.title: The Balance of Nature

458-complete.name: Tarindrella
458-complete.text: I see you found me, young $r.  Melithar is a wise $c to have sent you. But you still have much to learn. I understand your kind enjoys books. Please take one of these to further your education.
458-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-complete.name: Tarindrella
459-complete.text:
Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, $N.

You confirmed my fears, however.  If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.

Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able $C, seek out the knowledgeable $c, Athridas Bearmantle.  He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
459-complete.title: The Woodland Protector

459-progress.name: Tarindrella
459-progress.text: Satisfy my suspicions, $N.  Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.
459-progress.title: The Woodland Protector

460-complete.name: Shallow Grave
460-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  I had feared the Gnolls destroyed my body.  It is good to know they did not.
460-complete.title: Resting in Pieces

461-accept.name: Unknown
461-accept.text:
I know of a hidden niche within the keep that holds an item dear to Thule, and his old colleagues.  It also holds something you might find useful.  Take me there!

The alcove is in the southwestern tower of the keep, behind a dusty shelf.

Take my body, but leave my boots.  They never fit me anyway...
461-accept.title: The Hidden Niche

461-complete.name: Unknown
461-complete.text:
There we are, it's open.  Leave me here.  I spent the best days of my life in this keep, and the thought of resting within its walls gives me comfort.

Be sure to close the alcove tight - I don't want those Rot Hides to find me.

Oh, and take this.  You've earned it.
461-complete.title: The Hidden Niche

461-progress.name: Unknown
461-progress.text: This is the spot!  Bring me closer...
461-progress.title: The Hidden Niche

475-accept.name: Athridas Bearmantle
475-accept.text:
A troubling breeze blows through the forest.

Gaerolas Talvethren serves as Great Warden to the hibernating Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.  His duty as the chosen protector of the Sleeping is to ensure their safety so that their pact with Ysera remains fulfilled.

But word from Gaerolas is now delayed and I grow nervous.  Travel east to Starbreeze Village and bring back a report from Gaerolas so that I can put my worries to rest, knowing my dreaming brethren slumber safely.
475-accept.title: A Troubling Breeze

475-complete.name: Gaerolas Talvethren
475-complete.text: Thank the forest spirits you are here!  I knew Athridas would sense trouble and send help.
475-complete.title: A Troubling Breeze

476-accept.name: Gaerolas Talvethren
476-accept.text:
The Gnarlpine tribe has been corrupted!

The once peaceful furbolgs have turned against the protectors of the forest.  They ambushed me as I left for the Ban'ethil Barrow Den and proceeded to pillage Starbreeze Village.  Ursal the Mauler, their chieftain, is using the evil powers of the Fel Moss to drive them mad.

I am too wounded to return to Athridas to bring him this grave news.  The task is left to you, young $c.  We can only hope that the deranged Gnarlpines have not made it to Ban'ethil yet!
476-accept.title: Gnarlpine Corruption

476-complete.name: Athridas Bearmantle
476-complete.text: By the stars!  This is quite disturbing indeed!
476-complete.title: Gnarlpine Corruption

480-complete.name: Shadow Priest Allister
480-complete.text:
The magic of the wizards dissipates, and the ley energies fade into dormancy. Your efforts have been fruitful, $N, and we have dealt a major blow to our enemies, and to the overbearing wizards of Dalaran.

We must be vigilant, however, knowing that source of energy lies so close at hand... Plans must be made for the future.
480-complete.title: The Weaver

483-accept.name: Athridas Bearmantle
483-accept.text:
Gnarlpine invaders were seen ravaging the Ban'ethil Barrow Den to the west.

The slumbering druids will be trapped in the Emerald Dream for eternity, unaware of their fate, unless we help. The delicate hibernation ritual cannot be broken without the Relics of Wakening.

Journey to the Den and retrieve the Raven Claw Talisman, Black Feather Quill, Sapphire of Sky, and Rune of Nesting. The druids store them in sacred chests.  Return them to me and I will prepare the awakening ritual.
483-accept.title: The Relics of Wakening

487-accept.name: Moon Priestess Amara
487-accept.text:
The road to Darnassus must be kept safe.  Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe.

Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily.  We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people.

Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, $c.  Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point.  Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
487-accept.title: The Road to Darnassus

487-complete.name: Moon Priestess Amara
487-complete.text: You have served the good people of Dolanaar and Darnassus well, brave $c.  As a member of the Sentinel force of Teldrassil I salute your efforts.
487-complete.title: The Road to Darnassus

488-accept.name: Zenn Foulhoof
488-accept.text:
Eager for work, I see.  Lucky for you a day never goes by that I don't wish I had a fledgling $c to perform my bidding.

You see, $N, I can make you very happy and provide you with things you never dreamed of having.  But in order for that to happen you must bring me certain items.

My business in the forest often requires certain. . .reagents.  Fetch for me 3 Nightsaber Fangs, 3 Strigid Owl Feathers and 3 swatches of Webwood Spider Silk.

Let's keep this our little secret, $r.
488-accept.title: Zenn's Bidding

489-accept.name: Syral Bladeleaf
489-accept.text:
The Council of the Forest has news that you aided Zenn Foulhoof. The satyr is an enemy of the forest. As a $r, you should know better than to defile the forest by killing Nature's creatures.

You must redeem yourself in the eyes of the Council if you wish to remain a friend of Teldrassil.

Teach Foulhoof a lesson and you shall be redeemed. Fel Cones are corrupted seeds that fall from the trees. They billow with green smoke.

Give some to Foulhoof. He'll think you have brought him a harmless snack.
489-accept.title: Seek Redemption!

489-complete.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-complete.text: Ah, what a sweet $r!  I knew you would come in handy!
489-complete.title: Seek Redemption!

489-progress.name: Zenn Foulhoof
489-progress.text: What do you have for me, $N?  A lovely snack I presume?
489-progress.title: Seek Redemption!

491-accept.name: Unknown
491-accept.text:
Thule once told me that, long ago, he and two colleagues created a magic wand, woven together from the apprentice wands each mage possessed.  This wand was a symbol of their friendship, and although Thule came to despise it he could not part with it, nor could he let the others have it.  So he stole the wand, and hid it in Fenris Keep.

Here.  Take the wand to Bethor Iceshard, one of Thule's friends from years past.  I'm sure he will want it.
491-accept.title: Wand to Bethor

491-complete.name: Bethor Iceshard
491-complete.text:
...what is this?  Thule had our Woven Wand?  I thought it was lost when our friendship sundered and he sided with the Lich King!

He must not have invoked its power, for if he had I would have sensed it.  And it is good that he did not use it...

This is a marvelous find.  You have my gratitude, $N, and will be rewarded.
491-complete.title: Wand to Bethor

493-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
493-complete.text: Ah, most excellent.  Apothecary Renferrel has my utmost respect.  I am anxious to study his work.
493-complete.title: Journey to Hillsbrad Foothills

494-accept.name: Deathstalker Lesh
494-accept.text:
Be silent and pay attention, $c.

I was sent to this position in order to survey the town of Hillsbrad.  My mission is one of reconnaissance.  It is imperative that you send word to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill at once.  Let her know that I, Deathstalker Lesh, send the following message:

"The raven's cry from the west doth beckon."

Follow the road to the east and pay close attention to the signs.  Now, hurry!  Off you go to Tarren Mill, and with urgency I might add!
494-accept.title: Time To Strike

494-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
494-complete.text:
The raven's cry from the west doth beckon?

Superb news!  Hillsbrad is ripe for attack.  We can carry out our plan of destruction now.  Varimathras will be pleased.
494-complete.title: Time To Strike

496-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-accept.text:
Ah, another wretched day in Tarren Mill.  All of this clean air puts me in such a foul mood, $N.

The sooner we can plague the humans here, the better.  I've been conducting intense studies on possible killing agents to use in my concoctions but I haven't the time to collect them all.

If you want to make yourself of use, procure the following items for me:  10 Gray Bear Tongues and the very rare and hard to find, Creeper Ichor.  You'll find both bears and creepers just outside of Tarren Mill.
496-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

496-complete.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-complete.text: These specimens are perfect.  Well, $N, you have managed to bring me the slightest hint of joy on yet another miserable day.  Your efforts are appreciated.
496-complete.title: Elixir of Suffering

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

498-accept.name: Krusk
498-accept.text:
Me and some other warriors were sent by the Warchief to retrieve an object from Durnholde and to investigate this so-called Syndicate.

We went to Durnholde to take a look around, but we were taken by surprise by a large number of the humans. We fought bravely, but their sheer numbers were enough to defeat us. They took a few of us captive, but I was able to escape.

Durnholde is just southeast of here, across the river. Drull and Tog'thar are being held there, you must go and rescue them.
498-accept.title: The Rescue

499-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
499-accept.text:
It will take but a moment for me to mix these components into what I have deemed an Elixir of Suffering.

There we go!  Ah, nothing brightens a gloomy day in these miserable foothills like bringing a little suffering into the world.

Let us see if our little potion has achieved its desired effect.

Give my assistant Umpi a taste of what the Dark Lady has planned for both humans and Scourge alike.
499-accept.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-accept.text:
Oh, $N. . .the flowers are blooming in Hillsbrad and the air is so fresh and brisk.  I can't help but to wallow in the misery of it all.  I look out my grimy window and long for the day when our New Plague brings this world the death it deserves.

As much as I would love to sit and brood all day, my duty to the Dark Lady calls.  Help me, would you?  My research leads me to believe I can make the most splendid death-brew with the blood of a Mountain Lion.  Bring some to me and we'll have a little fun.
501-accept.title: Elixir of Pain

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

502-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
502-accept.text:
Ah, nothing like the smell of fresh blood in the foothills!

Now we'll mix in a touch of this and a little of that and let the real fun begin!  What I have created with this blood, I like to call an Elixir of Pain.  If my calculations are correct this concoction could be the start of something very beautiful for Lady Sylvanas.  But what we need is a test.

Take this elixir out to the northern farm in Hillsbrad Fields to the southwest.  Let's see how Farmer Ray's little dog Stanley likes this "treat."
502-accept.title: Elixir of Pain

502-complete.name: Stanley
502-complete.text: You pour some of the elixir into your hand and hold it before Stanley's mouth.
502-complete.title: Elixir of Pain

509-accept.name: Apothecary Lydon
509-accept.text:
Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out.  They seem bent on killing each other as is.

Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land?

Here's the plan, $N: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
509-accept.title: Elixir of Agony

527-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
527-accept.text:
Stand at attention while addressing me, $c.

I am under direct command of Varimathras.  We are to quell the human infestation until our apothecaries can develop the new plague.

Our information leads us to believe that the town of Hillsbrad is vulnerable to attack.  Your first assignment is aimed at disrupting their food supply and infrastructure.

Travel west.  Raid the northernmost farms of Hillsbrad Fields.  Make sure that the landowners, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz, are executed as well.
527-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

528-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
528-complete.text: The grip of death is tightening around the town of Hillsbrad.  The battle goes well.
528-complete.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-accept.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-accept.text:
The humans of Hillsbrad have been putting up unexpected resistance.  The problem appears to be that the townsfolk are being armed by the local blacksmith.  We need to shut down all supply lines.

Your mission will be to execute Blacksmith Verringtan.  Slay his apprentices as well.  While there, bring back a shipment of iron from their stockpile.  The supplies will come in handy when we are done with the conquering of Hillsbrad and begin razing Southshore.
529-accept.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

529-progress.name: High Executor Darthalia
529-progress.text: Were you able to carry out your orders, $c?  Did you dispose of Verringtan and his assistants?  And where is that iron shipment?
529-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

530-complete.name: Raleigh Andrean
530-complete.text:
Ah, good.  These hands killed my wife, Deliah.  Revenge for her murder was my only care, and you were the instrument of that revenge.

Here, take the ring you returned earlier.  Deliah has been dead to me for so long, her ring is a bauble I no longer care to keep.  Instead, I will keep these hands as a remembrance of my friend's betrayal.
530-complete.title: A Husband's Revenge

549-accept.name: Unknown
549-accept.text:
By the authority of Lady Sylvanas, all members of the organization known as the Syndicate are wanted dead. Those brought into custody or taken prisoner will be summarily executed. They are currently known to be amassing in the ruins of Durnholde Keep, to the southeast of Tarren Mill.

A handsome reward is offered to all who bring proof of their deeds to High Executor Darthalia.
549-accept.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

549-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
549-complete.text: Excellent, $c. At this rate, the Syndicate pest will be rid from the land in no time.
549-complete.title: WANTED: Syndicate Personnel

567-accept.name: Unknown
567-accept.text:
Dangerous!

The following humans of Hillsbrad have been deemed dangerous and are marked for bounty by High Executor Darthalia:

Clerk Horrace Whitesteed.  Wanted for the murder of Deathguard Toma.

Citizen Wilkes.  Wanted for the murder of Apothecary Eli.

Miner Hackett.  Wanted for the murder of Deathstalker Fry.

Farmer Kalaba.  Wanted for the ambush of supplies from the Undercity.

All of these enemies are hiding and will be hard to find.  A reward will be granted upon notice of their death.
567-accept.title: Dangerous!

567-complete.name: High Executor Darthalia
567-complete.text: You are quite the bounty hunter, $c.  Well done.
567-complete.title: Dangerous!

87288-progress.name: Aldia
87288-progress.text: It is good to see you again! Are you here to trade?
87288-progress.title: Soft Saber Pelts

916-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-accept.text:
I came to Shadowglen to observe the webwood spiders that dwell in the Shadowthread Cave.  They are cousin to a much smaller variety of spider; I believe the world tree has had a profound effect on them, and I would like specimens to study to confirm this.

First, I would like some of their venom.  Gather Webwood venom sacs from the spiders in and around the Shadowthread Cave, to the north.  I can then examine them for similarities with their smaller cousin's venom.
916-accept.title: Webwood Venom

916-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  When I return to Darnassus I will compare the venom within these sacs with the venom of other spiders.  It is my belief that it will have properties linked to the recent growth of our new world tree.
916-complete.title: Webwood Venom

916-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
916-progress.text: Did you gather the venom sacs, $N?
916-progress.title: Webwood Venom

917-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-accept.text:
Now that I have the spiders' venom, I'd like some live specimens to study.  Unfortunately, capturing a living, giant spider is more than I can ask of you, young $c.  And a giant spider is more than I could handle myself!

But if you can find an unhatched egg, then delivering specimens will be much easier, and I can then arrange for the unhatched spiders to be contained.

There must be a nest deep in the Shadowthread Cave.  Please, search for an egg in the nest and return it to me.
917-accept.title: Webwood Egg

917-complete.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-complete.text: Ah, very good.  I will have this egg and the venom transported to Darnassus, then return there when my studies are done here.  I expect to find out a great deal from these specimens, $N.  You have been a great help to me.
917-complete.title: Webwood Egg

917-progress.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
917-progress.text: Have you been inside the Shadowthread Cave, $N?  Did you find a spider egg?
917-progress.title: Webwood Egg

918-accept.name: Denalan
918-accept.text:
The timberlings of Teldrassil are elementals of nature.  In some ways they reflect the natural order of plants and animals on our great tree.

So it is disturbing to see how angry the timberlings have become.

I believe it has something to do with the soil.  I have been working on different methods of nurturing plants and would like to try them on timberling seeds.  Please, can you gather seeds from timberlings around Lake Al'Ameth and bring them to me?
918-accept.title: Timberling Seeds

918-complete.name: Denalan
918-complete.text:
You got them.  This is good!

I will plant these seeds in special soil I have prepared.  I believe the seeds will sprout into timberlings who are much more docile.  Perhaps later you can see the results!
918-complete.title: Timberling Seeds

918-progress.name: Denalan
918-progress.text: Do you have the seeds?  I am eager to plant them.
918-progress.title: Timberling Seeds

91858-accept.name: Danitha Morr
91858-accept.text:
A most unfortunate turn of events in Silverpine has presented a unique opportunity for us to prove our worth in the eyes of the horde.

A pair of dignitaries from the Earthen Ring went missing in Silverpine Forest en route to Tarren Mill. We don't know much else but rumors say that this is becoming quite the diplomatic incident. If we can recover these missing persons, it could help gain us the legitimacy we so dearly need.

We have a man at The Sepulcher, Trevan Rol. Travel there and speak with him.
91858-accept.title: Diplomatic Incident

91858-complete.name: Trevan Rol
91858-complete.text: Danitha sent you? Well in that case I already know why you are here. You just walked into a damned fine mess, $c.
91858-complete.title: Diplomatic Incident

91859-accept.name: Trevan Rol
91859-accept.text:
Cutting straight to it, these "dignitaries" are no ordinary diplomats. One was a Tauren. Ordinary enough for the Earthen Ring, but the other--and you'll scarcely believe this--was an elf. A *high* elf. They were cloaked, but I've seen quel'dorei before and I'd bet my good pinky finger that's what I saw.

Why was an elf accompanying a Tauren through horde territory? Well, your guess is as good as mine. That's as much as I know, so I'd suggest speaking with Deathguard Baldren near the entrance to town.
91859-accept.title: A Curious Pair

91859-complete.name: Deathguard Baldren
91859-complete.text: I might not care for you paladins, but I will say that your timing is impeccable. It's better to be lucky than good, I suppose?
91859-complete.title: A Curious Pair

91860-accept.name: Deathguard Baldren
91860-accept.text:
Out on patrol last night I spotted a group of gnolls dumping a very large body onto a pyre on the shores of Fenris Isle. I didn't see an elf or any smaller corpses, but I'd say this doesn't bode well for them.

If you are brave or stupid you are welcome to charge into Fenris Isle to learn more, but if you ask me, it's a lot of work to find some snooty elf that's probably long dead.

I know you paladins love swearing oaths and taking on lost causes, but this one isn't worth it. Trust me.
91860-accept.title: A Grim Fate

91860-complete.name: Deathguard Baldren
91860-complete.text:
<The corpse before you was certainly Tauren and you can tell that it was gnawed on heavily before it was tossed onto the pyre. You see no signs of the elf woman that was described to you though. Perhaps she is still alive somewhere deeper in the fortress nearby?

This will be dangerous, but there's only one way to find out for sure.>
91860-complete.title: A Grim Fate

91861-accept.name: Unknown
91861-accept.text: <The fact that you found only one body is a hopeful sign. Perhaps the High Elf that Trevan and Hadrec described is still alive somewhere deeper inside the nearby fortress?>
91861-accept.title: Into Fenris Keep

91861-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
91861-complete.text:
You are one of the Forsaken, yes? Can you help free me? 

Time is short for me, I am afraid. Please hurry!
91861-complete.title: Into Fenris Keep

91862-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-accept.text:
Quel'dorei? No, I am no "quel'dorei". I am Lumina Windsinger and I am shen'dorei. One of the Windshaper Skyborne.

I came to these lands as a guest of the Earthen Ring. My companion Banon and I were passing through Silverpine to reach the Arathi Highlands so that we could study the elemental convergences there. Clearly, we didn't make it.

We have no time for this now though. Kill the gnolls nearby. Retrieve the key to this cage and free me. I will tell you the rest once we are safely away.
91862-accept.title: Lumina Windsinger

91862-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-complete.text: Thank you, $c. Unfortunately we aren't out of danger yet.
91862-complete.title: Lumina Windsinger

91862-progress.name: Lumina Windsinger
91862-progress.text: Gnolls are the second worst creatures I've encountered yet on Azeroth.
91862-progress.title: Lumina Windsinger

919-accept.name: Denalan
919-accept.text:
Small timberlings are sprouting around the waters of Lake Al'Ameth.  I'm afraid these sprouts are beyond help -- we should try to clear them from the land before they grow large enough to cause trouble.

When you're wandering the lake, if you see any timberling sprouts please take them.  Help keep our land clean!
919-accept.title: Timberling Sprouts

919-complete.name: Denalan
919-complete.text:
That's a lot!  I'm afraid they're spreading at a dangerous rate.  I hope I can solve the riddle of what is tainting them.

Thank you for your help, $N.  The land is a cleaner place from your efforts.
919-complete.title: Timberling Sprouts

919-progress.name: Denalan
919-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found any sprouts near the waters?
919-progress.title: Timberling Sprouts

91921-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921-progress.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

920-accept.name: Gilshalan Windwalker
920-accept.text:
$N, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil.

We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
920-accept.title: Tenaron's Summons

920-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
920-complete.text: Ah, $N. I was hoping you'd be prompt in answering my summons. I have an important task that I would like you to perform.
920-complete.title: Tenaron's Summons

921-accept.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-accept.text:
It is time for you to set out to seek your destiny, $N. But before you are ready to set out into the world beyond our enchanted forests, there is much you must learn about our recent history.

Much has changed with our people since the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Nordrassil lies a pale shadow of what it once was, its power used to defeat Archimonde and drive back the Burning Legion...

There is a task you must perform. Go to the moonwell north of Aldrassil and return me a phial of its water.
921-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

921-complete.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-complete.text: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. There is much more to be told and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.
921-complete.title: Crown of the Earth

921-progress.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
921-progress.text:
The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.

The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.
921-progress.title: Crown of the Earth

922-accept.name: Denalan
922-accept.text:
$N, can you take one of the seeds you brought me to my friend, Rellian Greenspyre?  He is a $c in Darnassus, and when last we spoke he revealed his interest in my work with the Timberlings.  He had some ideas himself, and he will appreciate a specimen seed to work with.

Thank you, $N.  You have been a great help to me.  I hope that, some day, you will see the fruit of my labors.

You will usually find Rellian walking the pathways of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.
922-accept.title: Rellian Greenspyre

928-accept.name: Tenaron Stormgrip
928-accept.text:
While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of Teldrassil, I must send you along. Corithras Moonrage will be expecting you. I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.

Seek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of Shadowglen, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.

Mind you stay on the road though, $N. There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.
928-accept.title: Crown of the Earth

932-accept.name: Tallonkai Swiftroot
932-accept.text:
I must warn you, $N, this matter must stay between us. The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home.

He is called Lord Melenas. He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul.

You must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.
932-accept.title: Twisted Hatred

94436-accept.name: Danitha Morr
94436-accept.text:
It's time to demonstrate your ability to channel one of the light's greatest gifts.

The item I just gave you is called the Symbol of Life. Take care, as it may cause you some discomfort to handle a talisman of the light such as this. The light may be anathema to the force that created us, but it is still our guide and ally. The pain reminds us of this.

Go see Deathguard Billmuth downstairs. He just arrived and he has petitioned us for aid. Show him and the Forsaken what a true $c can do.
94436-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94438-complete.name: Deathguard Falgan
94438-complete.text:
I'm... back? And saved by a $c no less? I see you carry a Symbol of Life. I've not seen one of those since... well, since before the war when Lordaeron was a very different place. I can only assume you are here to help. Billmuth and I were sent here to scout out the scarlet activity here, and we found out that they are planning some kind of attack.

If you would be willing to help more, there may yet be more that you can do to help the Forsaken.
94438-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440-accept.name: Deathguard Falgan
94440-accept.text:
These Scarlet Crusaders often carry satchels with their deployment orders. We know an attack is coming, but if we can recover their orders, we can warn the rest of the Deathguard and prepare an ambush. 

You are clearly an impressive $c. Kill these scarlet animals and retrieve a copy of their orders and bring them back to Deathguard Billmuth. He'll take it from there.
94440-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94440-complete.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94440-complete.text:
Thank you for saving my friend, $N. I will take these plans back to my commander and we will give those crusaders a welcoming they won't forget.

I know that many among our people mistrust you paladins, but it's clear to me that you are Forsaken through and through. I won't forget this, and I'll make sure others know of what you did here today.
94440-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441-accept.name: Deathguard Billmuth
94441-accept.text:
Please give my thanks to Danitha Morr and tell her that the rest of the Deathguard will hear about the service that the paladins of Tyr's Watch performed for us. 

You have a lot of promise as a $c, and I am proud to have those like you among the ranks of the Forsaken. Dark Lady watch over you, $N.
94441-accept.title: A Lesson in Divinity

94441-complete.name: Danitha Morr
94441-complete.text:
The Symbol of Life is only able to be used by a $c who is ready to make use of one of the light's greatest blessings. I'm proud to count you among us, and I now bestow upon you the gift of redemption. With this you will be able to resurrect your fallen companions. Use this new boon wisely.

You have done well for both the Forsaken as well as the paladins of Tyr's Watch. Any steps we can take to win the hearts and minds of our fellow Forsaken is well worth the effort. Go with the light, $N.
94441-complete.title: A Lesson in Divinity

95034-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
95034-accept.text:
I think you should know that it wasn't actually the Gnolls who attacked us on the road.

We were actually attacked by a giant, wolf-like creature that I now know as a "worgen". It dispatched our guards and came for me, but Banon threw himself in its path. I managed to get a spell off which startled the creature, causing it to flee, but Banon was already badly bitten. He insisted I leave him there but I refused.

We were limping back here when the gnolls found us. What came next was terrifying...
95034-accept.title: The Debt

95034-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
95034-complete.text:
So now you understand. At the very end of his strength after being pierced by a dozen gnoll blades, he reared up to strike me. In that final moment we locked eyes, and I could tell he still knew who he was and that he recognized me. He knew what was happening but he had no control over himself. That was the worst part.

If such a thing is possible, I will see the creature that doomed him dead so that it can never visit this horror on another living thing. I swear it upon the sky above.
95034-complete.title: The Debt

95036-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
95036-accept.text:
Trevan tells me that the worgen are a major threat to the citizens of Silverpine Forest. Despite their strength and resilience they can be killed, but there is one in particular that just doesn't ever seem to stay dead due to unknown magic.

That's the one that attacked us. He is known as Old Fire-Eye and he is the biggest and meanest of their kind. To put him down, we'll need a special kind of weapon.

Speak with Trevan and he will supply you with a list of what is needed to forge such a weapon.
95036-accept.title: A Moon-Kissed Blade

96204-accept.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-accept.text:
Now that I'm free I'm going to make these vile creatures regret ever laying eyes on a Windshaper.

Let's get out of here, $c.
96204-accept.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

96204-complete.name: Lumina Windsinger
96204-complete.text:
Thank you again, $N. I've been acquainting myself with Trevan here, who I've learned sent you along on my trail.

I've heard... less than charitable things about paladins thus far in my travels. I'm pleased that those insinuations are quite unfounded.

You and your kind have a friend among the Windshapers.
96204-complete.title: The Windshaper's Wrath

97977-progress.name: Tarindrella
97977-progress.text: Don't worry about any larger totems you might find. I wouldn't know what to do with them if you found a way to get them!
97977-progress.title: Nature's Call

97979-accept.name: Shanda
97979-accept.text:
You are born kaldorei--the children of the stars--and have inherited a birthright unlike any other in this world. Elune's grace may illuminate our strengths, helping our strikes hit true, or it may help conceal us just as the moon may eclipse the sun.

Our Long Vigil after the defense of Mount Hyjal has ended, and we have joined an Alliance of others--which you will meet in due time. For now, you are nestled in the boughs of Teldrassil.

Demonstrate Mother $N's gifts, and bask in her blessings.
97979-accept.title: The Goddess Provides

98298-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
98298-progress.text: Fangs, claws, gizzards. It makes no difference to me. The easiest way to study something is to see the guts yourself.
98298-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

98391-accept.name: Laurna Morninglight
98391-accept.text:
Blessings to you, $c. The Sisterhood of Elune has stood as a pillar of kaldorei society for thousands of years.

Before the Great Sundering, before the War of the Ancients, through the Long Vigil, we have guided and healed our people through the darkness. Such is our charge, and such is the demand of the peerless Mother $N.

We now require your aid in a matter of great importance. Sister Aquinne awaits your arrival in Darnassus.
98391-accept.title: The Sisterhood of Elune

99-complete.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
99-complete.text: Your persistence is commendable.  With the knowledge you helped me gather, Arugal will fall and his reckless magic shall be undone.  Cheers to you, $N.
99-complete.title: Arugal's Folly

99-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
99-progress.text: Have you secured the Pyrewood Shackles yet, $N?
99-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

997-accept.name: Syral Bladeleaf
997-accept.text:
Are you heading to the south?  To Lake Al'Ameth?  If so, then I have a task I might ask of you...

My colleague Denalan has a camp along the eastern end of the lake, where he is studying and experimenting on the plant life of Teldrassil.  He requested a package of rare earths from Darnassus and it was late, only recently arriving here in Dolanaar.

Can you take the package to him?
997-accept.title: Denalan's Earth

997-complete.name: Denalan
997-complete.text:
Ah, it's here!  I have waited for this rare earth for quite some time.  I hope it's still fresh...

Thank you for bringing it to me, $N.  You are a $r who is generous with her time.
997-complete.title: Denalan's Earth
